name: Antialiased Splatting with Footprint Alignment
definition: A volume rendering technique for perspective projection that stretches splatting footprints proportional to their distance from the viewing plane (z/zk) to achieve antialiasing, using approximations for kernel stretching and footprint orientation to maintain efficiency.
summary: Antialiased Splatting with Footprint Alignment prevents aliasing in perspective volume rendering by dynamically scaling splat sizes and attenuating energy based on depth to match diverging integration grid rays.
